ATTENTION AI, INC.

Privacy Policy

Effective date: November 7, 2026 · Last updated: November 7, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Attention AI, Inc. (“Attention,” “we,” “us”) collects, uses, shares, and protects information when you use the Attention iOS app, the Attention voice recorder card, and related services (together, the “Service”). If you have questions, email wenxin@attentionai.dev.

The short version: we keep only your own voice, not the people around you. Mixed recordings are deleted after transcription, and your voice segments are kept for 60 days. We don’t sell your data, don’t use it for advertising, and don’t track you across other companies’ apps or websites. Nothing is sent, submitted, or paid for on your behalf without your explicit approval. You can delete your account and all your data in the app at any time.

What we collectAudio & voiceHow we use itService providersApple HealthConnectors & GoogleCloud browserRetention & deletionYour rightsChildrenContact

1. Information we collect

  • Account information. You sign in with Apple. We receive an Apple account identifier and, if you choose to share them, your name and email address (which may be an Apple private relay address).
  • Audio and transcripts. Audio you record with your iPhone’s microphone or with the Attention card, and the transcripts we create from it. See section 2.
  • Voiceprint. A voice profile of your own voice, used to tell your speech apart from other speakers’ so we keep only yours.
  • Content you create. Messages you send to the assistant, its responses, and artifacts, notes, or drafts produced in the app.
  • Wellness estimates. Mood and stress estimates the app derives from your conversations (see section 5).
  • Sleep data (optional). If you allow it, sleep analysis from Apple Health (see section 6).
  • Connected-account data (optional). If you connect services such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, or Calendly, the data those services make available under the permissions you grant (see section 7).
  • Device and notification data. An Apple Push Notification service token so we can send you notifications such as check-ins, and basic technical information needed to operate the Service.
  • Purchase information. Subscription status for Attention Pro as reported by Apple. Apple processes payment; we do not receive your card details.
  • Support communications. Anything you send us when you contact us.

2. Audio, voice, and the people around you

Attention records audio from your phone’s microphone or from the Attention card only when you use the recording features. After a recording is transcribed:

  • We use voiceprint matching to identify the segments spoken by you. Only your own voice segments are kept, for 60 days, after which they are deleted.
  • The original mixed recording, which may contain other people’s voices, is deleted. Other speakers’ audio is not retained.
  • Transcripts are stored on our servers, hosted by Amazon Web Services in the United States.

Recording other people. Conversations you record may include other people. You are responsible for complying with the recording and consent laws that apply where you are, which in some places require the consent of everyone in the conversation. See our Terms of Use.

3. How we use information

  • To provide the Service: transcribe recordings, separate your voice from others’, generate AI responses and summaries, schedule check-ins, and perform actions you request.
  • To operate your account and your Attention Pro subscription.
  • To send notifications you’ve enabled.
  • To keep the Service secure, prevent abuse, and fix problems.
  • To respond to you when you contact support.
  • To comply with law.

We do not sell your personal information, do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising, do not use it for advertising, and do not track you across apps and websites owned by other companies.

4. Service providers that process your data

We share data with the following providers only as needed to provide the feature you are using. They process it on our behalf and not for advertising.

  • Anthropic (Claude) — generates AI assistant responses.
  • ElevTalk — speech services: transcription and speaker identification.
  • Amazon Web Services — hosting and storage, in the United States.
  • Apple Push Notification service — delivers notifications to your device.
  • Apple — Sign in with Apple and in-app subscription billing.

We may also disclose information if required by law, to protect the rights, safety, or property of our users or others, or in connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, in which case this policy will continue to apply to your information.

5. Mood and stress estimates

Attention may show estimates of your mood or stress. These are wellness estimates only. They are not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and you should not rely on them for health decisions. If you have concerns about your health, talk to a qualified professional.

6. Apple Health (optional)

If you grant permission, Attention reads sleep analysis data only from Apple Health, and only to time your morning and evening check-ins. Attention never writes data to Apple Health. Health data is never used for advertising or marketing, is not sold, and is not shared with third parties. Our use of HealthKit data complies with Apple’s HealthKit guidelines and the App Store Review Guidelines. You can revoke access at any time in iOS Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices → Attention.

7. Connectors, including Google

You can optionally connect other services, such as Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Calendly, and others, through each service’s OAuth sign-in. We access only the permissions you grant, only to perform the tasks you ask for. You can disconnect a connector at any time in the app, or revoke access from that service’s account settings (for Google, at myaccount.google.com/permissions).

  • Gmail: Attention can read your email and create drafts. Nothing is sent without your explicit approval.
  • Google Calendar and Google Drive: used to look up and work with your events and files when you ask.

Attention’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Consistent with those requirements, we use Google user data only to provide and improve the user-facing features you request; we do not use it for advertising, do not sell it, and do not allow humans to read it except with your consent, for security purposes, or as required by law.

8. Cloud browser

When you ask, Attention’s agent can operate websites on your behalf in a browser that runs in the cloud. The agent stops and asks for your approval before any submit, pay, or send action, and it never types your passwords. The pages it visits and the actions it takes are processed only to complete your task.

9. Retention and deletion

  • Your own voice segments: 60 days, then deleted.
  • Mixed recordings: deleted after transcription.
  • Transcripts, content, and account data: kept while your account is active, until you delete them or your account.

Delete your account: in the app, go to Account → Delete Account. This deletes your account and all associated data. You can also email wenxin@attentionai.dev from the email associated with your account and ask us to delete it. Deleting your account does not cancel an Apple subscription; see Support.

10. Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

11. Your privacy rights

Wherever you live, you can ask us to access, export, correct, or delete your personal information by emailing wenxin@attentionai.dev. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request. We will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

California residents (CCPA/CPRA)

You have the right to know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose; to delete it; to correct it; and to opt out of its sale or sharing. We do not sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. You may use an authorized agent to submit a request.

EEA, UK, and Swiss residents (GDPR)

Attention AI, Inc. is the controller of your personal information. We process it to perform our contract with you (providing the Service), based on your consent (for example, Apple Health access, connectors, and voice features, which you can withdraw at any time), for our legitimate interests in securing and improving the Service, and to comply with legal obligations. You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. Your information is processed in the United States; where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards for international transfers.

12. Children

The Service is not directed to children under 13, or under 16 in the European Economic Area, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.

13. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you in the app or by other appropriate means before they take effect. The effective date above shows when it was last updated.
